description.en: Session handoff for long conversations: /handoff summarizes recent turns with an LLM, opens a new session in the same workspace with the summary as its first message, and can trigger automatically when the context window or session size grows.
description.zh: 长会话接力：/handoff 用 LLM 总结最近的对话轮次，在同一工作区新建会话并把总结作为首条消息注入后自动打开；上下文或会话体积变大时也可自动触发。
